Approved findings

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

AlpaGasus: Training A Better Alpaca with Fewer Data (2307.08701v1) · paper method: The study evaluates on Koala, Vicuna, WizardLM and Self-Instruct prompts with an API LLM judge such as GPT-4, comparing both response orders to mitigate position bias.

cohort3.claim.alpagasus.evaluation-design

  • This assertion originated as an author proposal; separate review receipts determine its current status.
  • Version-specific author-reported study; experiments, raw dataset records and formal proofs were not independently reproduced or verified.
  • This evaluation is automatic preference scoring, not human preference ground truth.

AlpaGasus: Training A Better Alpaca with Fewer Data (2307.08701v1) · paper method: The initial AlpaGasus study grades Alpaca instruction-input-response triplets with ChatGPT for accuracy and retains scores at least 4.5, selecting 9,229 of 52,002 samples.

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

AlpaGasus: Training A Better Alpaca with Fewer Data (2307.08701v1) · paper method: The 7B WizardLM-test analysis reports better-or-equal performance on 22 of 29 skills, but flags weaker coding categories and a keyword-defined coding-data removal rate of 88.16%, versus 82.25% overall.
